verdict.line: You lose if he lands his All Out all-in while your Riposte is down; you win if you parry that engage and stack vitals to shred his resistances.

brief.thesis: K'Sante's tankiness comes from stacking resistances through Path Maker and All Out, but Fiora's Passive (Duelist's Dance) vitals deal true damage that ignores all of it, so his scaling doesn't actually solve her damage. The real threat window is narrow and resource-gated: he can only commit to his full combo when his All Out energy bar is full, not just when R is off cooldown.

theirWindow.when: R ready and All Out bar full
theirWindow.what: Expect the full chain: W (Path Maker) dash to knock you into terrain, empowered Q (Ntofo Strikes) hit, E (Shadow Rush) follow. Hold Riposte for the first hard CC in that sequence, not for a stray poke.

yourWindow.when: he burns W/E and bar isn't full
yourWindow.what: He has no transform reset for this fight. Lunge in with Q, land a vital, and force the trade before he can rebuild the bar through autos.

powerCurve.note: empowered Q3 autos win early pokes
Riposte online, punish his committed dashes
All Out unlocks his real all-in
vitals true damage outpaces his resistances

start.why: sustain through his early auto trades without needing a full recall before level 6

boots.why: flattens his empowered Ntofo Strikes auto and his general on-hit poke as a bruiser

core.why: sheen proc adds burst onto vitals and the move speed lets you disengage bad All Out windows
lifesteal wins the extended trades his stacked resistances are designed to drag out
damage-over-time conversion lets you survive his burst chain long enough to parry and reset

situational.when: you are the clear priority target for his all-in
the enemy team stacks magic burst behind his engage
the enemy comp has more hard CC than just K'Sante's kit

runes.keystoneWhy: stacks through the extended duel he wants to force and converts to healing that offsets his sustain-through-combat kit

summoners.why: Flash resets your spacing away from walls before his knockup lands; Teleport lets you play the plate/split-push race you out-scale into instead of forcing skirmishes early

playing.title: Hold W for his real engage
playing.detail: Don't burn Riposte on a stray Q poke. Save it for Path Maker's dash or the empowered Ntofo Strikes hit that opens his all-in.

playing.title: Trade hard before level 6
playing.detail: He has no burst combo without All Out. Punish every W or E he throws out with Lunge resets.

playing.title: Fight away from walls
playing.detail: Path Maker's knockback and the All Out finisher only stun if you get knocked into terrain. Create space before committing to a trade.

playing.title: Stack vitals over raw damage
playing.detail: Prioritize landing Passive vitals with Q even over maximizing auto damage, since the true damage ignores every resistance stack he's built.

playing.title: Weave E between vital hits
playing.detail: Use Bladework's empowered autos to keep landing vitals on cooldown without needing to overextend into his stack count.

playing.title: Watch the energy bar, not just R
playing.detail: An empty All Out bar means he can't transform even with R up. That's your green light to all-in.

playing.title: TP to reset, don't force skirmishes
playing.detail: You out-scale past level 9. Take plates and tempo with Teleport rather than fighting into his level 6-8 spike.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names shift patch to patch; verify Fiora's current build (Trinity Force into lifesteal/Death's Dance) and K'Sante's exact All Out resource mechanics before locking this in.
